item.text:
Reconstructed all 40 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. The editions align across the preamble and nine numbered stanzas. Updated the title and right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I treated the opening title-and-name line as a heading. I rendered `Qunfuz` as `قنفذ` and read `Tu` after `dekha` as `تو` (“then”).
